GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Guten Tag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thank you
   B. good day (daytime greeting)
   C. good morning
   D. How are you?

2. The "ch" in "Nacht" is pronounced: (1 mark)
   A. like ch in chair
   B. like sh in ship
   C. like k in kite
   D. as a breathy sound at the back of the mouth

3. What is the gist of the text "Guten Morgen! Ich heiße Neema. Ich bin neun. Auf Wiedersehen!"? (1 mark)
   A. A girl greets, gives her name and age, and says goodbye
   B. A family goes to bed
   C. A boy asks for food
   D. Two friends talk about the weather

4. Which noun goes with "mein"? (1 mark)
   A. Schwester
   B. Mutter
   C. Vater
   D. Tante

5. Which sentence means "This is my sister"? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist meine Schwester.
   B. Das ist meine Bruder.
   C. Das ist mein Vater.
   D. Das ist mein Schwester.

6. What does "der Montag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. Saturday
   C. Monday
   D. Thursday

7. What does "der Freitag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. Friday
   C. Monday
   D. Wednesday

8. What does "gestern" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. often
   B. yesterday
   C. tomorrow
   D. always

9. What does "der Schnee" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thunderstorm
   B. wind
   C. cloud
   D. snow

10. What does "der Himmel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rainbow
   B. weather
   C. snow
   D. sky

11. What does "der Regen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloud
   B. wind
   C. snow
   D. rain

12. What does "sprechen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to eat
   C. to play
   D. to help

13. What does "Guten Abend" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good evening
   B. good night
   C. see you tomorrow
   D. What is your name?

14. How is the letter "ß" pronounced? (1 mark)
   A. like b
   B. like z
   C. like sh
   D. like a strong ss

15. Which little word goes with the noun "Schwester"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. das
   D. den

16. Why do "Let's eat, Grandma" and "Let's eat Grandma" mean different things? (1 mark)
   A. One has more words
   B. The comma changes the meaning
   C. Only the capital letters differ
   D. One is in German

17. What does "das Kind" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. uncle
   B. father
   C. brother
   D. child

18. Which little word goes with the noun "Schlafzimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

19. What does "Es hat vier Zimmer" mean? (1 mark)
   A. It has four rooms
   B. It has four doors
   C. It has four gardens
   D. It has four beds

20. Which day comes right before Dienstag? (1 mark)
   A. Mittwoch
   B. Donnerstag
   C. Montag
   D. Samstag

21. Which mark comes before a list or a quotation? (1 mark)
   A. das Komma (,)
   B. der Doppelpunkt (:)
   C. das Fragezeichen (?)
   D. der Punkt (.)

22. Which German word is the number 19? (1 mark)
   A. eins
   B. neunzehn
   C. elf
   D. zwölf

23. Which month comes right after "September"? (1 mark)
   A. Juni
   B. Mai
   C. Oktober
   D. August

24. What does "der Kakao" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. mango
   C. cheese
   D. cocoa

25. What does "der Mais" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. tomato
   C. watermelon
   D. banana

26. What does "Womit sehe ich?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What do I hear with?
   B. Who is that?
   C. What do I see with?
   D. Where do I sleep?

27. Which body part do we link with "riechen"? (1 mark)
   A. der Fuß
   B. das Ohr
   C. die Nase
   D. der Mund

28. What does "das Wetter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fog
   B. weather
   C. rain
   D. snow

29. Which little word goes with the noun "Regenbogen"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. der
   D. die

30. What does "trocken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. dry
   B. windy
   C. cloudy
   D. sunny

31. Which German word means "in front of"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. vor
   B. zwischen
   C. auf
   D. in

32. Which little word goes with the noun "Opa"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

33. What is the plural of "der Vater"? (1 mark)
   A. die Vateren
   B. die Vatere
   C. die Vaters
   D. die Väter

34. Which is the correct way to write "living room"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wohnzimmer
   B. das Wohnzimer
   C. die Wohnzimmer
   D. der Wohnzimmer

35. Which German word or phrase means "spoon"? (1 mark)
   A. der Löffel
   B. die Toilette
   C. die Lampe
   D. die Gabel

36. Which little word goes with the noun "Samstag"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. der
   D. die

37. Which word in the menu joins two foods? (1 mark)
   A. aber
   B. oder
   C. und
   D. nicht

38. Which little word goes with the noun "Gesicht"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

39. Which word completes "Mit den Ohren ___ ich"? (1 mark)
   A. sehe
   B. rieche
   C. höre
   D. spreche

40. What is the plural of "das Auge"? (1 mark)
   A. die Auges
   B. die Augen
   C. die Auge
   D. die Augene

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: face, father. (2 marks)

42. Rewrite correctly: "guten abend otieno" (2 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: candle, sky, cooker, knife. (4 marks)

44. Explain what reading in chunks means and why it helps. (2 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: thunderstorm, candle. (2 marks)

46. Write the German greetings for "good morning" and "good evening". (2 marks)

47. Explain the difference between "Es regnet" and "Es ist regnerisch". (2 marks)

48. Explain how the adjective "windig" is made from the noun "Wind". Give one more example. (2 marks)

49. Write a menu for one day in German with three meals. (3 marks)

50. Explain how your voice should change for a question mark and for a full stop. (2 marks)

51. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knee, garden. (2 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: balloon, arm, sister, shoulder. (4 marks)

53. Write the German words with der, die or das for: clock, leg, house, spoon. (4 marks)

54. Write three words from a Kenyan greeting or from German that must begin with a capital letter, and say why. (3 marks)

55. Explain why you should use reliable sources when you research a famous person's birthday. (2 marks)

56. Read: "Der Herd ist heiß. Das Messer ist scharf." Explain what the text warns about. (2 marks)

57. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shower, bean. (2 marks)

58. Write the German names of these months: October, November, December. (3 marks)

59. Write the German words with der, die or das for: water, rice, breakfast. (3 marks)

60. Write the German words with their articles for: rice, milk, egg, banana. (4 marks)

61. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cabbage or kale, toilet, fog. (3 marks)

62. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tea, tooth. (2 marks)

63. Write three sentences about what you do on three different days. Start each with "Am". (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — good day (daytime greeting)
   Guten Tag means good day (daytime greeting).

2. D — as a breathy sound at the back of the mouth
   After a, o and u the ch is a scratchy breath sound at the back of the mouth.

3. A — A girl greets, gives her name and age, and says goodbye
   The words Guten Morgen, ich heiße, ich bin neun and Auf Wiedersehen show a greeting, a name, an age and a goodbye.

4. C — Vater
   Vater is a der word, so we say mein Vater.

5. A — Das ist meine Schwester.
   Schwester is a die word, so we say meine.

6. C — Monday
   der Montag means Monday.

7. B — Friday
   der Freitag means Friday.

8. B — yesterday
   gestern means yesterday.

9. D — snow
   der Schnee means snow.

10. D — sky
   der Himmel means sky.

11. D — rain
   der Regen means rain.

12. A — to speak
   sprechen means to speak.

13. A — good evening
   Guten Abend means good evening.

14. D — like a strong ss
   ß is called Eszett and sounds like ss.

15. A — die
   It is die Schwester, so the little word is die.

16. B — The comma changes the meaning
   A comma shows a pause and can change the meaning of a sentence.

17. D — child
   das Kind means child.

18. A — das
   It is das Schlafzimmer, so the little word is das.

19. A — It has four rooms
   hat = has, vier = four, Zimmer = rooms.

20. C — Montag
   Before Dienstag comes Montag.

21. B — der Doppelpunkt (:)
   The colon announces a list or speech.

22. B — neunzehn
   19 in German is neunzehn.

23. C — Oktober
   After September comes Oktober.

24. D — cocoa
   der Kakao means cocoa.

25. A — maize
   der Mais means maize.

26. C — What do I see with?
   womit means with what.

27. C — die Nase
   We smell with the nose.

28. B — weather
   das Wetter means weather.

29. C — der
   It is der Regenbogen, so the little word is der.

30. A — dry
   trocken means dry.

31. A — vor
   in front of in German is vor.

32. C — der
   It is der Opa, so the little word is der.

33. D — die Väter
   The plural of der Vater is die Väter.

34. A — das Wohnzimmer
   Wohnzimmer is a das noun and begins with a capital letter.

35. A — der Löffel
   spoon in German is der Löffel.

36. C — der
   It is der Samstag, so the little word is der.

37. C — und
   und means and.

38. A — das
   It is das Gesicht, so the little word is das.

39. C — höre
   We hear with the ears.

40. B — die Augen
   The plural of das Auge is die Augen.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gesicht, der Vater.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Abend, Otieno!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for capital letters and 1 mark for punctuation.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Kerze, der Himmel, der Herd, das Messer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means reading groups of words together, so your reading sounds smooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the reason.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gewitter, die Kerze.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen and Guten Abend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each greeting spelled correctly.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Es regnet uses a verb and means it is raining. Es ist regnerisch uses an adjective and means it is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Add -ig to the noun: Wind + -ig = windig. Another example: Sonne + -ig = sonnig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule, 1 mark for the example.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Frühstück: Tee und Brot. Mittagessen: Reis und Bohnen. Abendessen: Ugali und Fisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meal correctly written.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: It goes up at a question mark and down at a full stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Knie, der Garten.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Luftballon, der Arm, die Schwester, die Schulter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Uhr, das Bein, das Haus, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen, Amina, Kenia. Nouns, names and the first word of a sentence begin with capitals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for examples, 1 mark for nouns, 1 mark for names.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Some information is wrong; reliable sources have been checked.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cooker is hot and the knife is sharp, so we must be careful in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each warning.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Dusche, die Bohne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Oktober, November, Dezember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Wasser, der Reis, das Frühstück.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

60. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, die Milch, das Ei, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tee, der Zahn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

63. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule. Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball. Am Sonntag gehe ich in die Kirche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with a capital letter, verb in second place and a full stop.
